peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE DEFENCE MECHANISM AND ITS ARB PATH. A basket-backed PSM with PROPORTIONAL-BASKET REDEMPTION is reasonable and arb-supported. ⚠️ PROPORTIONAL-BASKET IS THE LOAD-BEARING DETAIL AND IT CUTS BOTH WAYS: a redeemer receives a SLICE OF THE BASKET rather than a chosen asset, which protects the reserve from cherry-picking the best collateral, AND means the arb is only as attractive as the WEAKEST constituent. If one basket member is impaired, the whole redemption is discounted and the arb that defends the peg weakens exactly when it is needed.

backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES BASKET QUALITY AGAINST WHAT IS DONE WITH IT. ✅ The basket is genuinely blue-chip — USDC, USDT, PYUSD, BUIDL, BENJI — and that is a real strength, not a formality. ⚠️ HELD AT 5.5 BECAUSE THE RESERVES ARE ACTIVELY DEPLOYED RATHER THAN HELD: quality of the constituent and availability of the constituent are different questions, and a deployed reserve is subject to whatever it is deployed into. ⚠️ SO THE BASKET NAMES DESCRIBE WHAT IS OWED, NOT NECESSARILY WHAT IS SITTING THERE — do not read the constituent list as an inventory.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — basket composition and deployment, not a spot ratio
backing.backing_score_denominator: ⚠️ THE FEED CARRIES NO liquidity, backing OR peg BLOCK FOR THIS ASSET — every score here is uncontested by any measurement. Uncontested reads as settled and is not.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: ⚠️⚠️ THE BINDING WEAKNESS, AND THE TURNOVER FIGURE IS THE ONE TO READ: ~$5,800 OF 24-HOUR VOLUME ON A ~$62M CAP. That is under one-hundredth of one percent of the book trading in a day. DEX-only, no CEX. ⚠️ SECONDARY EXIT AT SIZE IS NOT AVAILABLE IN ANY MEANINGFUL SENSE — a holder of even a modest position is looking at the PSM, not the market, and the PSM returns a proportional basket rather than dollars. ⚠️ A DEPTH LADDER WOULD NOT CAPTURE THIS: a 2% probe measures what a pool would absorb in theory, and $5.8k/day says nothing is testing whether it would.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue structure and turnover, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️ NO COMPUTED DEPTH EXISTS FOR THIS ASSET — the feed carries no liquidity block.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: A disclosed Panama interface operator is not itself proof of a cUSD payout guarantee. Underwriter/borrower agreements and shared-security branding do not establish tokenholder beneficiary rights; the retained issuer mark is provisional. cUSD differs from stcUSD. Optional bilateral guarantees, reserve utilization and liquidator capacity constrain protection. Documentation that both calls redemptions guaranteed and warns of delay cannot support unconditional liquidity. Full reserve assurance is unestablished.
issuer.issuer_score_persistence: filtered — entity and track record, not spot-responsive
